name: Premium sleep automated with any LLM

assignments.name: CONCEPT_PROMPT
assignments.value:
=<Instructions>
Create one concept for a new sleep video on youtube.
My main theme is cute animals and characters in 3d style.
The length of the video is going to be 3 hours long, and it will be one looped video and a generated, classical music lullaby.
For the visual, make sure to create something where looping makes sense: small, gentle movements, that looks great when it's on repeat.
</Instructions>
<Examples>
	<Example>
		<Title>
          Brahms Lullaby For Babies To Go To Sleep Make Bedtime Super Easy Good Night And Sweet Dreams
    </Title>
		<Visual>
      This whimsical and serene image is a screenshot from a YouTube sleep video, designed to be calming and help viewers relax.
      The scene features two adorable, fluffy kittens with large, expressive eyes. One kitten is a soft pink, while the other is a gentle baby blue. They are set against a dreamy night sky filled with soft, purple and blue clouds, twinkling stars, and a crescent moon.
      Adding to the magical atmosphere are glowing, heart-shaped bubbles floating in the air and the silhouette of a fairytale-like castle in the distance. The overall art style is very soft and cute, typical of content created to aid with sleep and relaxation.
    </Visual>
	</Example>
	<Example>
		<Title>
          Soft Music for Sleep and Relaxing o Listening For 3 Minutes, Fall Into Deep Sleep o Remove Insomnia
    </Title>
		<Visual>
      This charming and heartwarming image, likely from a YouTube sleep video, captures a moment of pure sweetness and comfort.
      At the center of the composition is an irresistibly cute, fluffy white bunny with large, expressive dark eyes. The tiny creature is depicted nibbling on a large bar of milk chocolate, holding it with its small paws.
      The enchanting scene is further enhanced by an array of delectable chocolates scattered around the bunny, including truffles and other candy pieces. A warm, gentle glow emanates from a lit candle in the soft-focused background, casting a serene and cozy ambiance over the entire setting. Adding to the whimsical atmosphere, a cup or holder decorated with bunny ears can be seen in the background. The overall color palette is a soothing blend of warm browns, soft pinks, and creamy whites, creating a visually relaxing and dreamy experience perfect for a sleep video.
    </Visual>
	</Example>
</Examples>

assignments.name: CREATE_PROMPTS_PROMPT
assignments.value:
=<Instructions>
I'm creating a sleep video on youtube for the concept below. Help me to create the following materials:

1. Image prompt

Create a prompt for a nice visual, suitable for children and very cute.

2. Video prompt

Make sure the generated, 12s video can be easily looped, and the loops make sense. Make sure to include in the prompt, that things should not move in straight line, for example clouds should be still, a car shouldn't cross into the picture.

3. Music prompt

Create a prompt for a classical lullaby.
Include in the prompt: the music should be fully instrumental and designed for looping with no distinct intro or outro, just a continous main theme.
The music should be 60bpm at most.
</Instructions>
<Concept>
{CONCEPT}
</Concept>

assignments.name: THUMBNAIL_PROMPT
assignments.value:
=Create an image prompt to generate a thumbnail image that will be rendered using the input image attached to this prompt.
On top of the image, display a large text title, Centered in the middle of the image. Don't make other changes on the image.
The text style can include, glow, shadow, color. The colors should be described with words, not rgb or hex - just describe the desired colors with english. 

Using the following concept, create a great prompt for the thumbnail.
Concept: {CONCEPT}
